basis: config/fleet/nodes.yaml at 967da8131b43351e4799d8722899b1b174e99cb5; repository audit, not live reachability

owner_mesh.default_policy: deny until explicit owned admission, pinned host key, unique source key and ownership evidence
owner_mesh.provisioner: z0bridge owns authenticated discovery, BWS identity lifecycle, transport and orchestration
owner_mesh.api: scripts/fleet-ssh; also scripts/fleet ssh COMMAND OPTIONS

worker_lane_do_not_expand.egress: private and tailnet denied by cgroup

worker_lane_do_not_expand.transport_caveat: Tailscale SSH policies are separate from guest OpenSSH authorized_keys

local_runtime: OpenSSH with Ed25519, Include and restrict
requirements.ownership_snapshot: Authenticated tailscale status --json, independently collected by orchestrator; never trust remote self-report as sole admission authority
requirements.ownership_model: Stable ID + exact IP + User.LoginName; tagged nodes fail closed pending explicit verifier
requirements.identity: One node-local Ed25519 private identity per source, ~/.ssh/fleet/id_ed25519-NODE mode0600
requirements.host_trust: Independently verified host public key, SHA256 fingerprint, nonempty provenance; reject cloned host keys
requirements.phone_guest: kind=phone, proot=true for root; no systemd/cgroup requirements, no Android UI
requirements.path_hooks: Before .bashrc guard; existing bash login file without shadowing; .profile; fish conf.d
requirements.home_paths: Current uid ownership; refuse symlinks and group/world writable managed directories
requirements.secrets: No BWS access token, private identity or secret value in manifest or logs

integration_acceptance: Explicitly select owned hosts only, never every tailnet peer
Use owner kvn endpoint on Linux, never agentjob or Linux root
Keep existing authorized keys and SSH entries intact
Run path-install then install with authenticated ownership snapshot on each admitted source
Verify every source with --probe and aggregate exact directed edge matrix externally
Separate shell/tool probes from SSH true connectivity; installer does not install missing tools
Do not claim all-to-all from one source, offline verification, Online=false or Tailscale status alone
No root, firewall, ACL, password, sshd or service changes from this API
